_comment: ZincAI runtime config. Every value can be overridden by environment variables (env wins): MC_HOST, MC_PORT, MC_USERNAME, MC_VERSION, MC_AUTH, MC_CAN_DIG, AMD_API_BASE_URL, AMD_MODEL, AMD_API_KEY (or API_KEY), ZINC_DATA_DIR, LOG_LEVEL. Credentials: leave amd.apiKey EMPTY and pass AMD_API_KEY/API_KEY via the process environment (Pufferpanel 'secret variables'), or fill amd.apiKey here if the repo stays private. Never commit a real key to a public repo.

server._note: version '' = auto-detect (recommended for 26.3). auth 'offline' for whitelist name-join; 'microsoft' needs a real account and interactive device-code login.

amd._modelNote: Radeon Cloud Token Factory alias for the Qwen 3.8 27B free standing model. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 also works.
amd._lanesNote: maxConcurrent 2 = the chat lane and the action lane each have one call in flight, so a slow action call never holds a chat reply (set 1 if the endpoint refuses parallel requests; chat still goes first). chatTimeoutMs / chatMaxRetries: a shorter leash for chat replies.

inference._note: Two lanes: chat (answers people) and action (drives the body). Wake-ups are queued, never dropped. rpm is the shared calls-per-minute budget; chatReserve of those are for the chat lane alone (a mob chase used to spend all of them). urgentMinIntervalMs: the start of an escape or being cornered may be thought about this soon after the last call instead of minIntervalMs. heartbeatMs is the self-prompt when nothing happens (0 = off).

behavior._note: No friend list and no PvP switch: the bot never attacks a player unless the model names that player in the attack tool. Its reflex toward every real threat is to flee until the model decides.
behavior._languageNote: Every outgoing chat line is checked against this language (pt-BR only; '' switches the check off). A reply in another language is retried once, then replaced by a fixed line.

system1._note: Survival reflexes. eatBelowFood: eat under this hunger (never wasting food, except when hurt: then the bar is brought back to 18 so health regenerates). lowHealth: eat a golden apple if carried. fleeBelowHealth: too hurt to honour earlier decisions - flee from everything. mlgFallBlocks: shortest fall worth a water-bucket clutch. FLEEING: an escape starts when a threat is inside threat.radius and lasts while anything still follows inside releaseRadius or keeps closing; it is over after calmMs with nothing following. The model is told at the start, on material changes (at most every reportGapMs unless urgent), every stillFleeingMs while it lasts, and at the end; recallMs is how long the last escape stays in the prompts. fleeDistance is only used by the fallback planner.

combat._note: Only ever started by the attack tool. critThreshold is the fraction of the attack indicator required before a swing; vanilla cannot crit below 0.9, so values under 0.9 are raised to 0.9. maxChainKills: how many HOSTILE mobs of the named kind one attack call may take in a row; animals are one per call unless the call gives a count.

threat._note: What counts as a threat (threats.js) and how A* avoids it (PredictiveThreatMap). radius/rangedRadius: the trigger ring - how close a hostile mob (melee / ranged) must be to start an escape. Further out, up to 32 blocks, hostiles in the open are watched: counted for the model and used to decide when an escape is over. attackerMemoryMs: how long something that hit the bot stays a threat. Players are never threats unless they hit the bot.

traversal._note: Wind-charge traversal. Used only when A* reports noPath across a 3-5 wide gap or <=4 high wall.

scout._note: Optional startup Scout & Relocate (walks to the safest nearby anchor). OFF by default: the bot now stays where it spawns (its bed) and the flee reflex handles danger.

reconnect._note: After a session that had spawned successfully, reconnect with back-off when the server restarts or the link drops. A rejection on the FIRST join (whitelist, name) is still fatal: no retries, no renames.

places._note: Place memory: chests, furnaces, beds, signs seen while walking, plus named places. Stored in zincai-data/places.json. A storage room (more containers than fit on one prompt line) is shown as a summary with every label.
